resources.string: Extensions
Built-in capabilities, connected services, and skills
Built-in capabilities
Explore phone tools and their system permission requirements.
Connected services
Add remote MCP connections, discover tools, and grant access per tool.
Skills
Manage instructions and resources. Skills cannot grant tool access or enable connections.
These categories keep their own settings. Remote tools run on the connected service; skills describe how to use tools, not a code sandbox.

Grant access to individual tools in this connection. Authorized tools run automatically within task and entry-point constraints, without a prompt for each write; unauthorized tools do not run. New tools require authorization. If definition changes revoke a grant, review and authorize it again. Disabling closes direct tool access; it does not undo existing effects or block access through other general tools. Already started remote actions may still finish.
Task arguments are sent to this remote service. Use a distinct name for each account connection. Connecting and discovering tools does not authorize them.
